description: USD spot price for any major token. Pass either `symbol` (BTC, ETH, SOL, USDC, etc.) OR (chain + contract). Returns USD price, 24h change percent, market cap, fetched-at timestamp. CoinGecko-backed, cached 60s. $0.001 USDC.

chain.description: Chain slug: base, ethereum, solana, polygon, arbitrum, optimism, bsc, avalanche.

contract.description: Token contract address. Required with chain.

symbol.description: Token symbol like 'ETH'. Mutually exclusive with chain+contract.

name: token_price
